proposal.rationale: Perform pseudobulk aggregation by biological sample (sample_id) followed by DESeq2 differential expression analysis between fake_B and fake_A in Mono C cells, adjusting for batch effect (pool) and demographic covariates (sex and age).
expected_limitations: High dimensionality of batch covariate (pool) relative to sample size may lead to reduced degrees of freedom or overparameterization.
Pseudobulking low abundance cell subsets may lead to dropouts and reduced statistical power.
